text:
Source-assisted reading (research reader, Claude), reread on the native image of the text face (canvas 1, Stams_STA_Frg_240_01v, 4912 x 7360). Method: bands of about 380 px in two half-width columns (x 520-2560 and 2400-4480) from y 850 to 5840, autocontrast. Detail crops: the governor's protocol (550,4300-4480,4560, blue channel equalized), the dating clauses (2050,2270-3400,2410; 520,2700-4480,2940; 1950,3320-2950,3460; 1050,5420-4450,5800), the vicar's surname (1500,2160-2200,2260; 700,2440-1400,2540), the Barberiis forename (1300,1720-2300,1850; 1800,3000-2900,3110), and Pino Numai (520,4030-4480,4210; 520,4930-2600,5100). Act 2 (y 3320-4210, faint ink) rests on the image-only first reading, with its date and names reread. No outside text of the acts exists; the officials were checked against printed histories (snippets). Expansions in parentheses, uncertain readings (?), losses [...]. ss = s(upra)s(crip)tus.
